errors.apiNotConfigured: The API address is not configured. Set NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL to the backend URL (https://...).
errors.apiUnreachable: Could not reach the science service. Check that it is running.
errors.notJson: The server returned a response that is not JSON. Check that NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL points to the backend.
errors.analysisFailed: The analysis failed in the science service.
errors.analysisTimeout: The analysis timed out. Please try again later.
errors.jobFailed: The job failed in the science service.
errors.exportCors: A frame could not be read (CORS). The image server must allow this page's origin, so it cannot be exported from this browser.
errors.exportNoCanvas: This browser cannot draw on a canvas.
errors.exportPng: The PNG image could not be generated.

limitations.detectorsExcluded: Detectors {excluded} were excluded: a sequence uses one detector ({detector}) because SPHEREx detectors cannot be mixed.
limitations.epochsShown: {available} epochs available; {shown} evenly spaced ones are shown (maximum {max}).
limitations.noiseUnits: Each frame is shown in units of its own noise: useful to see motion, not to compare brightness between frames.
limitations.physicalScale: One physical scale for all frames: brightness changes between frames are real.
limitations.motionDetector: Motion mode uses detector D6 by default (about 4.4 to 5 µm): cold objects such as brown dwarfs are brighter at long wavelengths.
limitations.framesMissing: {count, plural, one {# frame} other {# frames}} could not be downloaded and are missing.
limitations.singleEpoch: Only one epoch is available, so no change over time can be seen here.
limitations.noFrames: No frames available to build a sequence at this position.
limitations.productsWithoutDetector: {count, plural, one {# product} other {# products}} without a detector were excluded.
limitations.brightnessWavelength: Brightness mode keeps frames at the same wavelength: {kept} of {total} are within ±{tolerance} µm of {wavelength} µm.
limitations.wiseUnavailable: The WISE reference frame could not be retrieved.
limitations.gaiaUnavailable: Gaia could not be reached: there are no comparison stars or catalogue marks.
limitations.noProperMotion: No proper motion known for this position: photometry uses a fixed position.
limitations.curvePerDetector: One curve per detector; detectors are never mixed. No aperture correction.
limitations.curvePerDetectorEpsf: One curve per detector; detectors are never mixed. Aperture flux corrected with the SPHEREx ePSF in {corrected} of {total} frames.
limitations.knownMotionSaturated: The target saturates or is flagged in most frames of this detector, so its position cannot be measured reliably.
limitations.knownMotionNoProperMotion: No proper motion is known for this position, so the known-motion check was not run.
limitations.knownMotionFewFrames: At least {needed} frames are needed for the known-motion check; found {found}.
limitations.knownMotionFieldTooLarge: The field is too large to run the known-motion check quickly ({size} px; at most {max} px); use a smaller field of view.
limitations.saturatedCore: The target saturates its core in this detector: the curve uses the amplitude of the PSF wings (relative values, not a flux).
limitations.notDetected: The target is not detected individually in each frame (median SNR {snr}); the curve mostly shows noise.
limitations.targetFlagged: The target is flagged (saturation or unusable pixels) in {flagged} of {total} frames in detector {detector}; try another detector.
limitations.notMeasured: The target could not be measured in these frames.
limitations.absoluteFlux: absolute flux (no valid comparison stars): not corrected for common changes
limitations.fewGaiaStars: Only {count, plural, one {# Gaia star was} other {# Gaia stars were}} measurable here (at least 3 unflagged with SNR ≥ 10 are needed), so the curve is absolute.
limitations.linearMotion: Linear motion over the observation window is assumed; a valid approximation for distant objects over a year and a half.
limitations.staticSources: Pixels that are significantly bright in the median of all visits were treated as static sources and subtracted (each with its own brightness per visit); movers slower than one PSF over the whole window may be subtracted with them.
limitations.minVelocity: Velocities below {velocity}″/yr (less than {pixels} px over the window) are not searched: they cannot be told apart from static residuals.
limitations.velocityEdge: The best velocity lies at the edge of the searched range; widen the range before trusting it.
limitations.gridReduced: Velocity grid reduced to {grid} to bound the computing cost.
limitations.minVisits: At least {required} visits are required; found {found}.
limitations.pValue: The empirical p-value compares the predicted position with random positions of the same stack; it assumes the catalogue proper motion is correct and the motion is linear.
limitations.smallMotion: Total predicted motion over the window is {pixels} px: below about 1.5 px a blind search cannot separate a mover from a static source, but a known motion can still be checked.
limitations.zodiImage: Zodiacal light (ZODI) was subtracted from the image.
limitations.zodiEvery: Zodiacal light was subtracted from every exposure.
limitations.dateColours: Different dates are shown in different colours: a brightness change over time is not spectral shape.
limitations.noWcs: No celestial WCS: detections have no sky coordinates.
